label: Calorie tracker app
text: I'm making a calorie and macro tracker app for phones. I use Claude Code. I don't really know what I need.

items.text: You're making a phone app where people log meals and track calories and macros
items.quote: calorie and macro tracker app for phones

items.text: You're not sure yet what you need
items.quote: I don't really know what I need

concepts.term: phone app for iPhone and Android
keeping Claude Code on track between sessions

needs.reason: Only if you add barcode scanning, which you didn't mention. Then Open Food Facts, a free list of packaged foods, can fill in calories and macros from a barcode.
Claude Code already does this. Each time it starts, it reads a notes file about your project called CLAUDE.md. Type /init in Claude Code and it writes one for you. Nothing to add.

expo-app-toolkit.why: You're making a phone app and don't know yet what you need. Expo's own guides show Claude Code how to start an app like yours.
expo-app-toolkit.how_it_helps: Claude Code follows Expo's guides to make each screen. It can also put together test versions of your app on Expo's computers.
expo-app-toolkit.do_you_need_it: Add it now, before anything else on this page.
expo-app-toolkit.skip_if: Skip it if your app was started with a tool other than Expo or React Native, such as Flutter. Or if it was made just for iPhone or just for Android. Not sure? Ask Claude Code.
expo-app-toolkit.summary: Expo's own add-on for Claude Code: how-to guides, test versions of your app, and help getting into the app stores.

usda-fooddata-central.why: Your tracker needs the calories and macros for every food people log. This gives your app those numbers.
usda-fooddata-central.how_it_helps: Claude Code can add a food search to your app. The key stays out of the app itself, because USDA turns off keys it finds in public.
usda-fooddata-central.do_you_need_it: Add it now if your app should fill in the numbers for people.
usda-fooddata-central.skip_if: Skip it if you already pay for another list of foods that covers your users' countries.
usda-fooddata-central.summary: USDA FoodData Central: a free list of foods and their nutrition. It needs a free access key.

supabase-backend.why: Your tracker keeps each person's meals and goals. This saves them online, under each person's own sign-in.
supabase-backend.how_it_helps: Claude Code can set up sign-in, and a place to keep food logs and goals. Supabase also has a step-by-step guide for apps made with Expo.
supabase-backend.do_you_need_it: Add it now if people will sign in or switch phones. If each log stays on one phone, it can wait.
supabase-backend.skip_if: Skip it if you already chose another place to keep your app's data online, such as Firebase.
supabase-backend.summary: Supabase's own add-on for Claude Code: online storage for your app, with sign-in. Claude Code can set it up.

sentry-crash-alerts.why: You didn't mention crashes. But once other people try your app, you'll want to know when it breaks on their phone.
sentry-crash-alerts.how_it_helps: Each crash report points to the exact spot in your app that failed. Claude Code can read it and help you fix the problem.
sentry-crash-alerts.do_you_need_it: Add it later, once you share your app with testers. Sentry's free plan lets one person, you, read the crash reports.
sentry-crash-alerts.skip_if: Skip it if you already get crash reports from another tool, such as Firebase Crashlytics.
sentry-crash-alerts.summary: Sentry's own add-on for Claude Code: crash reports from your app. Claude Code can read them to help you fix problems.
